# Professional Summary

I have several skills professionally within both the educational and work environment for about half a decade. This includes skills in customer service, computer literacy, critical thinking skills, sanitation, and technical skills. I currently possess a posititon at Claremont Toyota in a position called 'service greeter' that requires me to interact with customers by checking them in for service, updating them on their status in queue for the next avaiable advisor, and communicating with my team members to ensure efficiency in our service department. I am willing to work as a team player and have acted as a team leader during times of necessity, as well as sole member when having to adapt to certain environments.
